name: Jammu Institute of Ayurveda and Research College
description: JIAR is affiliated with the University of Jammu and is recognized by the Government of Jammu and Kashmir. JIAR is approved by the Central Council of Indian Medicine and the Ministry of AYUSH, Government of India, New Delhi.

name: Organ Diagnostic Centre
description: Organ Diagnostic Centre, established in 2000, is a leading diagnostic service provider in Eastern India, offering comprehensive pathology and radiology services. They operate an extensive network of centers across West Bengal, Bihar, and Assam, providing a wide range of medical tests and consultations.

name: Dentplus Multispeciality Dental Clinic, Old Panvel
description: 'Dentplus' is state of art dental clinic with all essential dental equipment and materials. Dr. Atish Korwar studied at prestigious institute AIIMS, New Delhi and specializes in endodontics. They provide all kinds braces for alignment of teeth - metal, ceramic, self ligating braces, clear alignes- invisalign,etc. Both doctors provide best possible treatment for the benefit of the patient. They also provide services like dental implants, zirconia crowns, oral surgical procedures, etc.

name: Eva Hospital
description: REVA HOSPITAL is a multi-specialty hospital and one of the leading healthcare service providers in central India. Located in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, it operates under the company name “Friends Unity Hospital & Research Centre.” The healthcare verticals of the company primarily comprise diagnostics and day care specialty facilities

name: Vimala Hospital
description: Vimala Hospital, Ettumanoor started functioning in 1974 and had been at the forefront of providing quality Gynaecological & Obstetrics Care for the last 45 years, in the Central Travancore area. Vimala Hospital, Ettumanoor was one among few Private Hospitals in India approved by Government of India, Ministry of Health & Family Planning, New Delhi as an approved Family Planning Hospital .The Family Planning Certificates issued from this Hospital were approved as an authenticated documents for claiming Advance Increments etc by Central Govt. Employees. We have been providing cost effective and high quality care. Now the hospital management has been taken over by the new generation and it has undergone tremendous renovation and functions as a Poly Clinic. We have now Jeevans Diabetes and Endocrine centre, Gynec and Infertility Treatment Department, Paediatrics Department, Cosmetology Dept, Pulmonology Department, Ortho and Surgery Department etc.

name: Swastha Hospital
description: Swastha Hospital, a unit of Helse Medical Sciences Pvt. Ltd., is one of the leading multi-speciality hospitals in Dibrugarh, Assam, committed to delivering affordable, ethical, and high-quality healthcare to the community. Strategically located on A.T. Road, we serve patients across Upper Assam, Arunachal Pradesh, and nearby regions with advanced medical care and personalized attention. We offer a wide range of super-speciality and speciality services including Cardiology, Nephrology, Urology, Medicine, Critical Care, Radiology, General Surgery, Orthopedics, Pain Management —under one roof. Our hospital features modern ICUs, CATH Lab, 24/7 emergency care, in-house diagnostics, dialysis units, and pharmacy — all designed to ensure seamless and efficient treatment. At Swastha Hospital, we are led by a team of renowned doctors, skilled nurses, and trained healthcare professionals who are focused on delivering evidence-based, patient-centered care. We emphasize patient safety, timely diagnosis, and transparent treatment at every stage of care. As one of the fastest-growing hospitals in Dibrugarh, we also lead community health initiatives including free medical camps, outreach OPDs, preventive health screenings, and awareness drives, making healthcare accessible beyond hospital walls. Swastha Hospital is here for you—with compassion you can trust and care you deserve.

name: Ramakrishna Mission Sevashrama - Kankhal, Haridwar, Uttarakhand
description: Ramakrishna Mission Sevashrama (RKMS) is a charitable hospital at Kankhal, Haridwar in Uttarakhand. It is a branch center of Ramakrishna Mission, Belur Math, Howrah, West Bengal. Established in 1901 by Swami Kalyanananda, a direct monastic disciple of Swami Vivekananda. The hospital serves poor patients and monks in and around Uttarakhand, and has served more than 10 million patients.

name: Beramji’s Hospital
description: Beramji’s Hospital was established by Dr R.F. Beramji & Dr Mrs Y.R. Beramji in 1977 as a Medical Clinic. It grew into a Surgical Hospital with departments of General Surgery, Gynaecology, Orthopaedics, Gastroenterology, Urology, Physiotherapy and Acupuncture. In 2001 the hospital converted to Acupuncture and integrated therapy (Physiotherapy, Diet, Kerala Ayurveda Therapy, Podiatry).

name: Shivani Hospital and IVF, Shastri Nagar, Kanpur
description: Shivani Hospital & IVF, Shastri Nagar, Kanpur, is a multi-speciality hospital with over 30 years of experience, known for Minimal Access Surgery, Obesity Management, and infertility care including IVF. It features a 4K laparoscopic system—the first in Uttar Pradesh and Uttarakhand—and has been recognized as a center with Fellowship of the National Board (FNB) in Reproductive Medicine.

name: Bejan Singh Eye Hospital
description: Bejan Singh Eye Hospital is a comprehensive eye care facility located in Kanyakumari, Tamil Nadu, founded by Dr. Bejan Singh. The hospital offers a wide range of ophthalmic services including cataract surgery, glaucoma treatment, and low vision aids, catering to patients from Tamil Nadu and Southern Kerala. With a commitment to quality care, the hospital is associated with various health schemes and organizations, ensuring accessibility for government employees and pensioners. The hospital has grown significantly since its inception in 1992, now boasting 110 beds and a dedicated team of specialists.

name: Hfrc Dialysis Center
description: Haryana Foundation & Research Centre running HFRC Dialysis Centre for poor & needy people.

name: AVP Kapil Ayurveda Chikitsalayam
description: Multi-specialty hospital specializing in Kerala Ayurvedic treatments, panchakarma therapies, and holistic wellness products.

name: Mahatma Gandhi Cancer Hospital & Research Institute
description: Mahatma Gandhi Cancer Hospital & Research Institute (MGCH & RI) is a NABH-accredited cancer hospital in Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, India. It began in 2006 as a 6-bedded day-care 'Vizag cancer hospital' and expanded to a 225-bed comprehensive multi-disciplinary cancer hospital by 2011, serving multiple states including Andhra Pradesh, Odisha, Chhattisgarh and Andaman & Nicobar Islands.

name: Advanced Neuro Hospital
description: Advanced Neuro Hospital Patna? was started 19 years ago in Best Neuro Hospital in Patna with all the equipment required for treatment & rehabilitation. Over the years, it has enhanced its equipment, employed highly-qualified, experienced, dedicated , Senior Consultant Neurologist in Patna ,Dr Udayan Narayan ,M.B.B.S(Hons.& Gold Medalist)Pat., M.D(Med.) ,M.D.(Paed.), D.M(Neuro.)Delhi. He is a renowned name in the Neurology, He is one of the Best Neurologist in Patna, and he has working in Advanced Neuro Hospital Patna for 16 Years as a Senior Neurologist. Dr. Udayan Narayan is one of the top neurologist in India. Advanced Neuro Hospital has developed as a Regional Centre for all kinds of complex neuro and spine-related diseases in Patna.

name: Zydus Medical College and Hospital, Dahod
description: Zydus Medical College and Hospital, Dahod is a self-financed brown field medical college having Public Private Partnership (PPP) with Government of Gujarat under health policy-2016. It is managed by Zydus Foundation, Ahmedabad and affiliated to Shri Govind Guru University, Godhra. It is located at Nimnaliya, Post-Muvaliya, Dahod,Gujarat-389151. Zydus Medical College and Hospital is providing tertiary health care services to tribal and needy population of eastern Gujarat and adjacent districts of Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan states.

name: Lotus Eye Hospital and Institute - Mulanthuruthy
description: Part of Lotus Eye Hospital and Institute, with a location in Mulanthuruthy, Kerala, India. The organization has been providing super speciality eye care since 1990, with centers in Tamil Nadu and Kerala.

name: Shivakrupa Hospital
description: Shivakrupa hospital is one of the most popular and reputed hospitals of Hubli. It was established in the year 1991. During those times, Hubli needed a standard and reliable ICU. Dr. M.S. Bembalgi, a renowned anaesthesiologist and visionary started this hospital keeping in mind the needs of the city. Dr. Shobhaa Bembalgi soon joined hands with him which boosted the growth of the hospital substantially. The hospital is presently a 50 bedded multispecialty hospital including a 5 bed ICU. The dedicated team of doctors and support team of the hospital keep striving hard not only to maintain and improve the quality of services but also to reform them so as to keep abreast of the growing needs and trends of health care. We are presently catering to the healthcare needs of entire north Karnataka along with patients coming from Maharashtra, Goa, Andhra Pradesh, Orissa, etc. Amongst the list of our patients we also include patients from Uganda, Philippines & Dubai.

name: Amala Hospital
description: Amala Hospital is referenced in connection with Amala De Addiction Center, located in Pattavayal on the Kerala-Karnataka-Tamil Nadu border in India.

name: Swami Pranavananda Homoeopathic Medical College And Hospital
description: Swami Pranavananda Homoeopathic Medical College and Hospital is a homeopathic medical college. It was founded in 1967 offering degrees in Homeopathy. It is located in Chhatarpur, Madhya Pradesh. It is affiliated to Madhya Pradesh Medical Science University, Jabalpur and recognised by the Central Council of Homeopathy, New Delhi.

name: Delhi Child Care and Dental Hospital
description: DELHI CHILD CARE AND DENTAL HOSPITAL is a government-recognized healthcare facility located in Bathinda district, Punjab. It provides comprehensive healthcare services under Ayushman Bharat – Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojna (PM-JAY).

name: Aravind Eye Hospital
description: Referral hospital outside the state listed under Assam Government schemes (AAN/Atal Amrit Abhiyan).

name: MK Hospitals
description: MK Hospitals is an Indian Multi-speciality hospital situated at Mahbubnagar District, Telangana, India.Founded in 2021 by Dr.Karuna Rathod, MD, DVL( Dermatologist) and Dr.Mahesh Kumar, MBBS, MD(General Medicine and Diabetologist), PGI Chandigarh.

name: Community Health Center Achara
description: Part of Punjab's secondary healthcare network anchored by District Hospitals, Sub Divisional Hospitals, and Community Health Centres, all linked through a structured referral system from primary care institutions.

name: Nandadeep Eye Hospital
description: Nandadeep Eye Hospital (नंदादीप नेत्रालय) is a group of super-speciality eye hospitals and Ophthalmology and Optometry educational institute with locations across Maharashtra and Karnataka.

name: Vydehi Ayurveda Hospital / Clinic (VAYU) – Whitefield
description: Ayurveda is the ancient method of treatment. Vydehi hospital is a leader in offering affordable Ayurvedic care,equipped with a green campus in the heart of Bengaluru. It is a full fledged healing center where the holistic methods are followed. We deliver authentic Kerala Ayurveda treatments and medicines.We take very good care of the patients based on balance between the body,mind and soul. Vydehi’s goal is to improve overall health and find a permanent solution to the disease by natural methods. We have developed a relationship of trust with the patients with well-experienced doctors to provide high quality treatment. Vydehi Ayurveda Centre is a complete Ayurvedic treatment centre with both in-patient and out-patient facilities. Vydehi Ayurveda Centre has curative, preventive & rehabilitative treatments. This Ayurveda Centre is 1600 bedded, state of art multi-specialty hospital.We offer Ayurveda care for hair,skin, diabetes, sciatica,weight loss and stress management using the ancient texts of Ayurveda. We customize each treatment to suit the nature of the patients. We specialize in providing Panchakarma treatment to detoxify the body and to get rid of unwanted stress from the mind.

name: Express Clinics Pune
description: Pune-based Express Clinics offers a variety of services including consultations with general physicians and specialists, pathology and radiology and custom health packages. It currently operates 26 clinics in Pune, Delhi, Mumbai and Bangalore.

name: GB MultiCare Hospital
description: GB Multicare Hospital Pvt. Ltd. is a Multi-speciality hospital located in the heart of Nagpur city, catering to the population of Nagpur, Vidarbha, Madhya Pradesh, Chattisgarh, Andhra Pradesh and various rural areas of Central India. It is a state of the art hospital providing all the services under one roof. It is a pioneer project established in July 2012 and equipped with various department. A classified accommodation is also available for various categories of patients. 24 hrs emergency, Trauma, Accidents, 8 Bedded well equipped Intensive Care Unit, Laminar Operation Theatre, Laproscopy / Endoscopy, General Surgery, Ventilators, C-arm

name: Rajasthan Hospitals
description: Started in 1982, The Rajasthan Hospitals of the trust provides treatment for all types of Uro-genital diseases with latest equipment. It has a unique distinction of providing first time in India the non-operative treatment of Enlarged Prostate by Microcomputer controlled electronic Hypothermia, Non operative painless removal of kidney stones is carried out by Lithotripsy treatment. The latest equipment allows increased accuracy by digital image processing capabilities and stone visualization.

name: Verma Hospital
description: Verma Hospital, Jalandhar was established in 1979 to serve the ailing humanity especially of Jalandhar District and adjoining areas of Punjab, Himachal Pradesh and Jammu and Kashmir.

name: Critical Care Hospital & Research Institute
description: Critical Care Hospital & Research Institute is a hospital in Guwahati, Assam. It oversees the paramedical training institute Critical Care Institute VTC at Lokhra Chariali, affiliated to NCVRT, New Delhi, and recognized by the Government of India.
